trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: User expresses the intent to set up instalments and exhibits a time-pressured persona.
steps.text: हॅलो, मला माझी fee instalments मध्ये pay करायची आहे. माझ्या कडे जास्त वेळ नाहीये, पटकन करा.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge intent and request the application ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी नक्की मदत करतो. Process सुरु करण्यापूर्वी, तुमचा application ID सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: User provides the application ID.
Request verification factors before proceeding.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Account verify करण्यासाठी, तुमचं registered name आणि date of birth सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: User provides verification factors and reiterates time pressure.
steps.text: माझं नाव राहुल आहे आणि DOB 14 August आहे. लवकरात लवकर करा, मला meeting ला जायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and set expectations for the next step.
steps.text: Verification पूर्ण झालं आहे. मी तुमची fee details check करतो, एक second द्या.

steps.purpose: Look up the fee account details.
Return the fee account details.
State the fee details and scholarship percentage before offering a plan.
steps.text: तुमची fee details check केली आहेत. तुमच्या account वर scholarship 0 percent आहे. 50000 paid आहेत आणि due amount 135000 आहे.

steps.purpose: User confirms the amount and asks for instalment options.
steps.text: बरोबर. मला ही due amount instalments मध्ये pay करायची आहे. किती options आहेत?

steps.purpose: Prompt the user for the number of instalments.
steps.text: तुम्ही ही amount 2, 3, किंवा 4 instalments मध्ये divide करू शकता. तुम्हाला किती instalments हवे आहेत?

steps.purpose: User specifies the number of instalments, with an STT error.
Clarify the corrupted STT input.
steps.text: माफ करा, मला थोडासा आवाज break झाल्यासारखा वाटला. तुम्हाला 3 instalments set करायचे आहेत का?

steps.purpose: User confirms the number of instalments and urges speed.
steps.text: हो, 3 instalments. Please पटकन सांगा किती amount pay करावी लागेल, मला एक call घ्यायचा आहे.

steps.purpose: Set expectations before making the consequential tool call.
steps.text: मी तुमचा plan set करतो, कृपया line वर राहा.

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan.
Return the instalment plan details.
State the active plan status and the per-instalment amount.
steps.text: तुमचा instalment plan active झाला आहे. तुम्हाला प्रत्येक instalment साठी 45000 pay करावे लागतील.

steps.purpose: User asks for the plan ID.
steps.text: Ok. आणि plan ID काय आहे माझा?

steps.purpose: Provide the plan ID from the tool result.
User asks for the due date of the first instalment.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. हे 45000 मी कधी पर्यंत pay करू शकतो?

steps.purpose: Refuse to state a due date since it was not provided by the tool.
steps.text: माफ करा, पण माझ्या system मध्ये due date ची माहिती उपलब्ध नाहीये. तुम्हाला portal वर check करावं लागेल.

steps.purpose: User accepts the resolution and ends the conversation.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, मी portal वर जाऊन first instalment pay करतो.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.

variant_findings.reason: The agent avoids invoking tools without mandatory arguments. It asks for verification factors in e4 before calling 'verify_customer_identity', and it explicitly asks the user for the number of instalments in e13 before calling 'setup_instalment_plan'.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Invocation > Partial Invocation Prevention

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses strictly on the tool outputs, quoting the exact fee and scholarship details (e11), the instalment amount and active status (e20), and the plan ID (e22). Furthermore, it refuses to hallucinate a due date in e24 because the tool did not provide one.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
